title: Missing Beacon
description: An array contains n distinct integers chosen from the range 0 through n. Exactly one value from that range is missing. Find the missing value.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; all array values are distinct; 0 <= values[i] <= n.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n integers.
hints: Pair equal values using XOR, or compare the expected and actual sums carefully.

examples.explanation: The range 0 through 5 contains every value except 3.
The only missing value from 0 through 3 is 3.
